# Configuration reference

Every key `config.yaml` accepts, generated from the Pydantic schema (`TPS2Config`). Sections are listed in the order they are first reached from the top level.

!!! warning "Unknown keys are ignored, not rejected"
    The schema does not currently forbid extra keys, so a misspelt key is silently dropped and its default used.

## DomainConfig

Spatial domain configuration.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dem` | Path \| None | `None` |  |
| `bbox` | list[float] \| None | `None` |  |
| `dem_source` | str | `'glo_90'` |  |
| `spatial_mode` | str | `'clusters'` |  |
| `grid_resolution` | float \| None | `None` |  |
| `crs` | str \| int \| None | `None` |  |
| `horizon_n_directions` | int | `8` | Number of azimuth directions (8 = every 45°) |
| `horizon_max_distance_m` | float | `3000.0` | Maximum search distance in meters |
| `svf_mode` | `'full'` \| `'centroid'` \| `'approximate'` | `'centroid'` | SVF computation mode: "full" (all pixels), "centroid" (cluster centroids only), "approximate" (cos(slope)) |
| `points` | [PointsConfig](#pointsconfig) \| None | `None` | Points mode configuration |
| `dem_buffer_m` | float \| None | `None` | Buffer radius (m) around each point for DEM patch download in sparse points mode. None = auto (horizon_max_distance_m + 1000) |
| `mask_shapefile` | Path \| None | `None` | Optional polygon shapefile restricting the modelling domain to its footprint. When set, clustering only covers pixels inside the polygon union (e.g. a basin shapefile); the DEM is still downloaded over bbox/extent. Relative paths resolve against the config file directory. |
| `mask_buffer_m` | float \| None | `None` | Optional buffer (m) applied to the mask polygons before rasterizing, to avoid clipping basin-edge pixels. None = no buffer. |

## ClusteringConfig

TopoSUB clustering configuration.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | str | `'kmeans'` |  |
| `features` | list[str] | `['elevation', 'slope', 'cos_aspect', 'sin_aspect', 'svf']` |  |
| `n_clusters` | int | `100` |  |
| `feature_standardization` | bool | `True` |  |
| `minibatch_batch_size` | int \| None | `None` | MiniBatchKMeans batch size (used automatically when samples > 500K) None = auto (256 * n_cores), or specify explicitly for tuning |
| `feature_weights` | list[float] \| None | `None` | Feature weights: multiply each feature by its weight AFTER standardization If None, all features have equal weight (1.0) Length must match features list |
| `terrain_adaptive` | bool | `False` | Terrain-adaptive clustering: split domain by slope threshold into flat (x,y only) and mountain (full feature set) zones, allocating more clusters to mountains where elevation/aspect differentiation matters. |
| `terrain_slope_threshold` | float | `5.0` | Slope threshold (degrees) separating flat from mountain terrain |
| `terrain_mountain_fraction` | float | `0.75` | Fraction of n_clusters allocated to mountain zone (rest go to flat) |

## SurfaceTypeConfig

Surface type classification configuration.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | str | `'custom'` |  |
| `stratify` | bool | `True` |  |
| `types` | dict[str, [SurfaceTypeEntry](#surfacetypeentry)] | `{}` |  |
| `raster_path` | Path \| None | `None` | Path to custom surface type raster (GeoTIFF). Values: 0=open, 1=glacier, 2=forest, 3=rock, 4=water. |
| `glacier_source` | str | `'none'` | Glacier classification source: 'rgi', 'custom', or 'none' |
| `rgi_version` | str | `'7.0'` |  |
| `rgi_regions` | list[str] | `[]` | NSIDC RGI region ids to load when glacier_source='rgi', e.g. ['13_central_asia', '14_south_asia_west']. Required for that source. |
| `rgi_cache` | Path \| None | `None` | RGI download cache directory (default ~/.cache/tps2/rgi7). |

## DownscalingConfig

Downscaling method selection.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `'simple'` \| `'full'` | `'full'` | Mode: "simple" uses only surface data (ERA5-Land compatible), "full" uses pressure-level interpolation (requires ERA5 pressure levels) |
| `lapse_rate` | float | `0.0065` | Lapse rate for simple mode [K/m], default 6.5 K/km |
| `temperature` | str | `'lapse_rate'` | The next four keys are INFORMATIONAL ONLY: they are recorded and shown by `tps2 info`, but the engine does not read them. Temperature follows `mode` (pressure levels in full mode, `lapse_rate` in simple mode); radiation is always the slope/aspect/horizon/sky-view correction; wind is the log profile, plus Winstral exposure if `wind_config.method: winstral`; humidity is specific humidity, with RH recomputed. |
| `radiation` | str | `'toposcale'` |  |
| `wind` | str | `'log_profile'` |  |
| `precipitation` | str | `'none'` | Precipitation downscaling method. Default "none" = pass source precip through unchanged (no elevation gradient). A fixed precip-elevation gradient is poorly constrained in high-relief terrain, so it is opt-in: set "elevation_gradient" and tune `precip_gradient` to enable it. |
| `precip_gradient` | float | `0.0003` | Fractional precip increase per metre of elevation gain. Only applied when precipitation == "elevation_gradient". 0.0003 = +3%/100m (legacy default). |
| `phase_method` | str | `'wet_bulb'` | Rain/snow phase partitioning variable. "wet_bulb" (default) uses a pressure-aware psychrometric wet-bulb temperature — a better predictor than air temperature in dry/high terrain, where snow falls well above 0degC air temp. "air_temperature" restores the legacy 2 m air-temperature split. |
| `t_snow_threshold_c` | float | `-0.5` | Rain/snow thresholds [degC] for the linear mixed-phase ramp: all snow below t_snow_threshold_c, all rain above t_rain_threshold_c. Defaults are recentred for wet-bulb (which runs below air temperature). |
| `t_rain_threshold_c` | float | `2.5` |  |
| `t_air_max_c` | float | `4.0` | Air-temperature guard rail [degC]: precipitation is forced to all-rain above this air temperature regardless of the wet-bulb temperature. Prevents snow at implausibly warm air temps in very dry air (where wet-bulb can sit below freezing). Set high (e.g. 99) to disable. No-op for "air_temperature". |
| `humidity` | str | `'standard'` | informational only, see above |
| `wind_config` | [WindConfig](#windconfig) | *(defaults)* | Phase 2: Wind and redistribution configs |
| `redistribution` | [RedistributionConfig](#redistributionconfig) | *(defaults)* |  |
